findings.title: Prevent overflow in the invoice total.
findings.rationale: Invoice.Cents accepts any int64, so total += inv.Cents can overflow and return an incorrect total. Define an overflow policy: return an error when the sum exceeds the int64 range, or use a wider numeric representation. Add positive and negative overflow tests.
